schema_rows: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX active_cycle ON domain_objects(project) WHERE kind='ResearchCycle' AND json_extract(body,'$.status') IN ('PLANNED','RUNNING')

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX active_run ON domain_objects(project,json_extract(body,'$.task_id')) WHERE kind='Run' AND json_extract(body,'$.status') IN ('QUEUED','STARTING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','RECONCILING','LOST')
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX artifact_content ON domain_objects(project,json_extract(body,'$.content_hash'),json_extract(body,'$.kind')) WHERE kind='Artifact'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX billing_event ON domain_objects(project,json_extract(body,'$.policy_id'),json_extract(body,'$.provider_event_id')) WHERE kind='BudgetLedgerEntry'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX budget_provider_event ON domain_objects(project, json_extract(body,'$.provider_event_id')) WHERE kind='BudgetLedgerEntry'

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX client_sessions_run
  ON client_sessions (run_id) WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX evidence_snapshot ON domain_objects(project,json_extract(body,'$.canonical_url'),coalesce(json_extract(body,'$.upstream_revision'),''),json_extract(body,'$.snapshot_artifact_ref.content_hash')) WHERE kind='Evidence'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX experiment_task_single ON experiment_tasks(project,task)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX message_dedup ON domain_objects(project,json_extract(body,'$.dedup_key')) WHERE kind='AgentMessage'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX no_progress_key ON domain_objects(project,json_extract(body,'$.key_hash')) WHERE kind='NoProgressRecord'

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notification_dedup ON domain_objects(project,coalesce(json_extract(body,'$.release_id'),''),coalesce(json_extract(body,'$.resource_request_id'),''),json_extract(body,'$.recipient_id'),json_extract(body,'$.channel')) WHERE kind='Notification'

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX research_one_active_cycle
ON domain_objects(project)
WHERE kind='ResearchCycle' AND json_extract(body,'$.status') IN ('PLANNED','RUNNING')
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX research_one_current_monitor ON intent_plan_bindings(project) WHERE monitor_current=1
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX resource_open_key ON domain_objects(project, json_extract(body,'$.dedup_key')) WHERE kind='ResourceRequest' AND json_extract(body,'$.status') IN ('OPEN','ACKNOWLEDGED')

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX source_cursor ON domain_objects(project,json_extract(body,'$.source_id'),json_extract(body,'$.query_hash')) WHERE kind='SourceCursor'

CREATE TABLE artifact_use_proofs (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, artifact TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
 use_hash TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(manifest_ref)),
 PRIMARY KEY(project,artifact,run,epoch)
)

CREATE TABLE artifact_uses (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, artifact TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL,
 epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(epoch>0), principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id),
 storage_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uploaded_content(storage_key),
 receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)),
 PRIMARY KEY(project,artifact,run,epoch,principal), UNIQUE(storage_key)
)
CREATE TABLE auth_credentials(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id), expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE auth_grants(principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id), project TEXT NOT NULL, task TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', run TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', restricted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(principal,project,task,run))
CREATE TABLE auth_principals(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, roles TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(roles)), can_create_project INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE backup_restore_barriers(project TEXT NOT NULL,run TEXT NOT NULL,restored_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(project,run))

CREATE TABLE client_command_queue (
 principal TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 session_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, goal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 generation TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES client_queue_fences(generation), queue_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
 request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, accepted_writer_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
 delivery TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(delivery IN ('STEER','FOLLOW_UP')), content TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ENQUEUED','SENDING','SDK_ACCEPTED','CONSUMED','DROP_REQUESTED','DROPPED','UNKNOWN')),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_receipt_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(principal,project,command_id), UNIQUE(generation,queue_sequence)
)

CREATE TABLE client_control_receipts (
 receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL,
 command_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, body_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 previous_receipt_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE client_control_requests (
 principal TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 session_id TEXT NOT NULL, control_request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 target_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_ids TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('REQUESTED','RECONCILING','CONFIRMED')),
 original_response TEXT, final_response TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(principal,project,command_id)
)

CREATE TABLE client_queue_fences (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 generation TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('OPEN','SEALING','SEALED','CANCEL_FENCED','RECONCILING')),
 accepted_through INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, sealed_through INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 run_id TEXT, runtime_epoch INTEGER, dispatch_key TEXT, manifest_hash TEXT, process_identity TEXT,
 restore_fenced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(restore_fenced IN (0,1)),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(project,task_id)
)

CREATE TABLE client_sessions (
  id                            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id                    TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision                      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 1),
  created_at                    TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at                    TEXT NOT NULL,
  goal_id                       TEXT,
  task_id                       TEXT,
  run_id                        TEXT,
  writer_epoch                  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (writer_epoch >= 1),
  writer_client_id              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(writer_client_id) >= 1),
  lease_expires_at              TEXT,
  event_watermark               INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (event_watermark >= 0),
  upstream_session_id           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(upstream_session_id) >= 1),
  upstream_log_id               TEXT,
  upstream_log_hash             TEXT CHECK (upstream_log_hash IS NULL OR (length(upstream_log_hash) = 71 AND upstream_log_hash GLOB 'sha256:[0-9a-f]*')),
  workspace_ref                 TEXT,
  title                         TEXT,
  model_config_ref              TEXT,
  core_build_id                 TEXT,
  transcript_artifact_id        TEXT,
  resume_requires_explicit_user INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (resume_requires_explicit_user IN (0,1)),
  sealed_at                     TEXT,
  archived_at                   TEXT,
  protocol                      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'researchos-client/2' CHECK (protocol = 'researchos-client/2')
)

CREATE TABLE consumer_inbox(consumer TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, applied INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(consumer,event_id), UNIQUE(consumer,project,sequence))
CREATE TABLE consumer_positions(consumer TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(consumer,project))

CREATE TABLE context_changes(project TEXT NOT NULL, proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL, author TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id), contract_hash TEXT NOT NULL, original_values TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project,proposal_id))
CREATE TABLE context_imports(project TEXT PRIMARY KEY, manifest_hash TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL, inventory TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE context_projection(consumer TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(consumer,project,kind,id))
CREATE TABLE decision_lineage(project TEXT NOT NULL, receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL, root_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0), PRIMARY KEY(project,receipt_id))

CREATE TABLE domain_objects (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
 body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)), content_hash TEXT, immutable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 PRIMARY KEY(project,kind,id), UNIQUE(project,kind,id,revision)
)

CREATE TABLE domain_refs (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, field TEXT NOT NULL,
 target_project TEXT NOT NULL, target_kind TEXT NOT NULL, target_id TEXT NOT NULL, target_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(project,kind,id,revision) REFERENCES domain_versions(project,kind,id,revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 FOREIGN KEY(target_project,target_kind,target_id,target_revision) REFERENCES domain_versions(project,kind,id,revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 CHECK(target_project=project OR (target_project='' AND target_kind IN ('BudgetPolicy','RunPolicy')))
)

CREATE TABLE domain_versions (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)), content_hash TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(project,kind,id,revision)
)
CREATE TABLE evaluation_native_tools(project TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, registered_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project,content_hash))
CREATE TABLE event_state_snapshots(project TEXT NOT NULL,event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES outbox(id),revision INTEGER NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)))

CREATE TABLE evidence_origins (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL, origin_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation IN ('ROOT','DERIVED')),
 basis_artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id), recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL, basis_root_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', basis_relative_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 PRIMARY KEY(project,evidence_id),
 CHECK((relation='ROOT' AND origin_id='') OR (relation='DERIVED' AND origin_id<>''))
)
CREATE TABLE evolution_builds(project TEXT NOT NULL,artifact TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(project,artifact))
CREATE TABLE evolution_candidates(project TEXT NOT NULL,candidate TEXT NOT NULL,creator TEXT NOT NULL,plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(project,candidate))

CREATE TABLE evolution_executions(project TEXT NOT NULL,candidate TEXT NOT NULL,phase TEXT NOT NULL,run TEXT NOT NULL,epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('RESERVED','RECORDED','FAILED')),body TEXT NOT NULL,receipt_hash TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(project,candidate,phase))
CREATE TABLE evolution_hosts(project TEXT PRIMARY KEY,body TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE evolution_journal(sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,project TEXT NOT NULL,candidate TEXT NOT NULL,run TEXT NOT NULL,event TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE evolution_release_operations (
  project TEXT NOT NULL,
  candidate TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('START_CANARY','ROLLBACK','PROMOTE')),
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expected_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(expected_epoch)='integer' AND expected_epoch > 0),
  admission_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(admission_hash)=64 AND admission_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  effect_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PREPARED','DISPATCHED','OBSERVED','FAILED','PROJECTED')),
  receipt_digest TEXT,
  projection_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (typeof(projection_revision)='integer' AND projection_revision >= 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (project,candidate,action),
  CHECK ((status IN ('OBSERVED','PROJECTED') AND receipt_digest IS NOT NULL AND length(receipt_digest)=64 AND receipt_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') OR
         (status IN ('PREPARED','DISPATCHED','FAILED') AND receipt_digest IS NULL)),
  CHECK ((status='PROJECTED' AND projection_revision>0) OR (status!='PROJECTED' AND projection_revision=0))
)

CREATE TABLE evolution_slots(project TEXT PRIMARY KEY,active_hash TEXT NOT NULL,stable_hash TEXT NOT NULL,candidate TEXT,epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('STABLE','CANARY','RECOVERING')))

CREATE TABLE evolution_tasks(project TEXT NOT NULL,task TEXT NOT NULL,candidate TEXT NOT NULL,phase TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(phase IN ('REGRESSION','CANARY')),PRIMARY KEY(project,task),UNIQUE(project,candidate,phase))

CREATE TABLE experiment_executions(project TEXT NOT NULL, experiment TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('RESERVED','RECORDED','FAILED')), body TEXT NOT NULL, receipt_hash TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(project,experiment,run,epoch))
CREATE TABLE experiment_runs(project TEXT NOT NULL, experiment TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, preregistration_hash TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project,experiment,run))
CREATE TABLE experiment_tasks(project TEXT NOT NULL, experiment TEXT NOT NULL, task TEXT NOT NULL, bound_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project,experiment,task))

CREATE TABLE idempotency(principal TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, status INTEGER NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, headers TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(principal,project,operation,key))

CREATE TABLE intent_plan_bindings (
 project TEXT NOT NULL,
 requirement TEXT NOT NULL,
 submission TEXT NOT NULL,
 actor TEXT NOT NULL,
 raw_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 accepted_revision INTEGER,
 planning_goal TEXT,
 planning_task TEXT,
 brief_ref TEXT,
 acceptance_ref TEXT,
 compiled_goal TEXT,
 node_mapping TEXT, plan_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DELIVERY'
 CHECK(plan_kind IN ('DELIVERY','MONITOR')), monitor_current INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
 CHECK(typeof(monitor_current)='integer' AND monitor_current IN (0,1)), monitor_started_at TEXT, monitor_progress_id TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(project, requirement),

)

CREATE TABLE orchestration_contracts (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, task TEXT NOT NULL, contract TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(contract)),
 frozen_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project,task)
)

CREATE TABLE orchestration_failures (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, key_hash TEXT NOT NULL, reason_hash TEXT NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(project,key_hash,reason_hash)
)
CREATE TABLE orchestration_fixtures (project TEXT NOT NULL,runtime TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project,runtime))

CREATE TABLE orchestration_goal_contracts (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, goal TEXT NOT NULL, contract TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(contract)),
 PRIMARY KEY(project,goal)
)

CREATE TABLE orchestration_identity (
 principal TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth_principals(id),
 root TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id), parent TEXT REFERENCES auth_principals(id)
)

CREATE TABLE orchestration_rejections (
 correlation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL,
 principal TEXT, status INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(status>=400), code TEXT NOT NULL,
 body_hash TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE orchestration_run_dependencies (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(snapshot)),
 PRIMARY KEY(project,run)
)

CREATE TABLE orchestration_task_controls (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, task TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL, requested_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project,task)
)
CREATE TABLE outbox(project TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, body TEXT NOT NULL, acknowledged INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(project,sequence))
CREATE TABLE page_cursors(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, grant_hash TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE remote_audit(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, actor TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE remote_challenges(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id), token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, projects TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(projects)), expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE remote_devices(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth_principals(id), owner TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id), body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)))
CREATE TABLE remote_refresh(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, device TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES remote_devices(id), expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE remote_replays(actor TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, response BLOB CHECK(response IS NULL OR operation IN ('updateDeviceGrants','revokeDevice')), expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(actor,operation,key))

CREATE TABLE research_candidate_reviews (
  project TEXT NOT NULL,
  cycle_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  profile_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  context_target TEXT NOT NULL,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('REJECT','WATCH','INCONCLUSIVE','ADOPT')),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(reason)>0),
  missing_evidence TEXT,
  revisit_trigger TEXT,
  origin_summary_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(origin_summary_json)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL, reviewer_id TEXT, review_task_ref TEXT, acceptance_ref TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY(project,cycle_id,evidence_id),
  CHECK(outcome NOT IN ('WATCH','INCONCLUSIVE') OR
    (length(missing_evidence)>0 AND length(revisit_trigger)>0))
)

CREATE TABLE research_cycle_work (
 project TEXT NOT NULL,
 cycle TEXT NOT NULL,
 logical_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(logical_key)>0),
 plan_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(plan_ref) AND json_type(plan_ref)='object'),
 stage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(stage IN ('discovery','verification','experiment','review','delivery','follow_up')),
 task TEXT NOT NULL,
 experiment TEXT,
 source_id TEXT,
 evidence_id TEXT,
 input_refs TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(input_refs) AND json_type(input_refs)='array'),
 input_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_hash)>0),
	parameters TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(parameters) AND json_type(parameters)='object'),
 window_from TEXT,
 window_to TEXT,
 progress_record_id TEXT,
 source_receipt TEXT CHECK(source_receipt IS NULL OR (json_valid(source_receipt) AND json_type(source_receipt)='object')),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(project,cycle,logical_key),
 UNIQUE(project,cycle,task),
 CHECK((window_from IS NULL)=(window_to IS NULL)),
 CHECK(stage='discovery' OR source_receipt IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE research_monitor_cycles (
 project TEXT NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE resource_effects(project TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, effect_key TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)), PRIMARY KEY(project,run,effect_key,sequence))
CREATE TABLE resource_progress_resumes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)))
CREATE TABLE resource_progress_runs(project TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)), PRIMARY KEY(project,run))
CREATE TABLE resource_resolutions(request TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)))
CREATE TABLE resource_route_grants(project TEXT NOT NULL, runtime TEXT NOT NULL, purpose TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)), PRIMARY KEY(project,runtime,purpose))
CREATE TABLE resource_route_history(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)))
CREATE TABLE resource_write_lock(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), value INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE retrieval_dedupe (
 principal TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(principal,project,key)
)

 project TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),

CREATE TABLE runtime_bindings (
    project TEXT NOT NULL, runtime TEXT NOT NULL,
    profile_ref TEXT NOT NULL, profile_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    technical_hash TEXT NOT NULL, owner TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(project,runtime)
)

CREATE TABLE runtime_dispatches (
    project TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
    dispatch_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('PREPARED','STARTED','OBSERVED','UNKNOWN')),
    worker TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', journal_locator TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    identity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    observation_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    observation_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

CREATE TABLE runtime_observations (

 receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)), observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(project,run,epoch,receipt_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE runtime_qualification_approvals (
    project TEXT NOT NULL, runtime TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    qualification_hash TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL,
    receipt_ref TEXT NOT NULL, approved_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(project,runtime,revision)
)

CREATE TABLE runtime_qualification_plans (
    project TEXT NOT NULL, task TEXT NOT NULL, runtime TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan TEXT NOT NULL, plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    author TEXT NOT NULL, author_root TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(project,task)
)

CREATE TABLE runtime_qualification_runs (

    runtime TEXT NOT NULL, epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
    plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL, profile_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_hash TEXT NOT NULL, input_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_bundle TEXT NOT NULL, owner_root TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(project,task), UNIQUE(project,run)
)

CREATE TABLE runtime_uploads (
 storage_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES uploaded_content(storage_key),
 project TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, epoch INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
    version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
)

CREATE TABLE source_pages (
 project TEXT NOT NULL,
 cursor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 query_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 window_from TEXT NOT NULL,
 window_to TEXT NOT NULL,
 page_cursor_in TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 page_cursor_out TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 raw_artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 item_refs_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(item_refs_json) AND json_type(item_refs_json)='array'),
 complete INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(complete IN (0,1)),
 fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 cursor_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SourceCursor' CHECK(cursor_kind='SourceCursor'),

 PRIMARY KEY(project,cursor_id,window_from,window_to,page_cursor_in),
 FOREIGN KEY(project,cursor_kind,cursor_id) REFERENCES domain_objects(project,kind,id),
 FOREIGN KEY(project,artifact_kind,raw_artifact_id) REFERENCES domain_objects(project,kind,id),
 CHECK((complete=1 AND page_cursor_out='') OR (complete=0 AND page_cursor_out<>''))
)

CREATE TABLE uploaded_content(storage_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT NOT NULL, principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id), bytes BLOB NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TRIGGER artifact_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON domain_objects WHEN OLD.kind='Artifact' AND (NEW.content_hash IS NOT OLD.content_hash OR json_extract(NEW.body,'$.storage_key') IS NOT json_extract(OLD.body,'$.storage_key') OR json_extract(NEW.body,'$.access_class') IS NOT json_extract(OLD.body,'$.access_class')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'sealed content'); END

CREATE TRIGGER artifact_metadata_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON domain_objects WHEN OLD.kind='Artifact' AND json_remove(NEW.body,'$.revision','$.updated_at','$.validity') != json_remove(OLD.body,'$.revision','$.updated_at','$.validity') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'sealed metadata'); END

CREATE TRIGGER backup_require_fresh_observation BEFORE UPDATE ON domain_objects
WHEN NEW.kind='Run' AND json_extract(NEW.body,'$.lease_epoch')>json_extract(OLD.body,'$.lease_epoch')
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM backup_restore_barriers b WHERE b.project=NEW.project AND b.run=NEW.id)
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runtime_observations o JOIN backup_restore_barriers b ON b.project=o.project AND b.run=o.run WHERE o.project=NEW.project AND o.run=NEW.id AND o.epoch=json_extract(OLD.body,'$.lease_epoch') AND o.observed_at>b.restored_at AND json_extract(o.body,'$.children_stopped')=1 AND json_extract(o.body,'$.queue_empty')=1)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'RESTORE_FRESH_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'); END

CREATE TRIGGER client_session_require_fresh BEFORE UPDATE OF writer_epoch ON client_sessions
		WHEN NEW.writer_epoch > OLD.writer_epoch
		AND NEW.run_id IS NOT NULL
		AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM backup_restore_barriers b WHERE b.project=NEW.project_id AND b.run=NEW.run_id)
		AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects r WHERE r.kind='Run' AND r.project=NEW.project_id AND r.id=NEW.run_id
			AND json_extract(r.body,'$.status') IN ('QUEUED','STARTING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','RECONCILING','LOST'))
		AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runtime_observations o
			WHERE o.project=NEW.project_id AND o.run=NEW.run_id
			AND o.observed_at > (SELECT max(b.restored_at) FROM backup_restore_barriers b WHERE b.project=NEW.project_id AND b.run=NEW.run_id)
			AND json_extract(o.body,'$.children_stopped')=1 AND json_extract(o.body,'$.queue_empty')=1)
		BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'RESTORE_FRESH_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'); END

CREATE TRIGGER evolution_release_operation_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON evolution_release_operations
WHEN OLD.project IS NOT NEW.project OR OLD.candidate IS NOT NEW.candidate OR OLD.action IS NOT NEW.action OR
     OLD.operation_id IS NOT NEW.operation_id OR OLD.expected_epoch IS NOT NEW.expected_epoch OR
     OLD.admission_hash IS NOT NEW.admission_hash OR OLD.effect_key IS NOT NEW.effect_key OR
     (OLD.receipt_digest IS NOT NULL AND OLD.receipt_digest IS NOT NEW.receipt_digest) OR
     (OLD.status=NEW.status AND (OLD.receipt_digest IS NOT NEW.receipt_digest OR OLD.projection_revision IS NOT NEW.projection_revision)) OR
     (OLD.status!=NEW.status AND NOT (
       (OLD.status='PREPARED' AND NEW.status IN ('DISPATCHED','FAILED')) OR
       (OLD.status='DISPATCHED' AND NEW.status='OBSERVED') OR
       (OLD.status='OBSERVED' AND NEW.status='PROJECTED')))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'release operation is immutable or transition invalid'); END

CREATE TRIGGER evolution_release_operation_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON evolution_release_operations
WHEN NEW.status!='PREPARED' OR
     EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evolution_release_operations WHERE project=NEW.project AND candidate=NEW.candidate AND action=NEW.action) OR
     EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evolution_release_operations WHERE operation_id=NEW.operation_id) OR
     EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evolution_release_operations WHERE effect_key=NEW.effect_key)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'release operation must begin prepared and cannot replace identity'); END

 json_extract(OLD.body,'$.preregistration_hash') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.body,'$.preregistration_hash') OR
 json_extract(OLD.body,'$.candidate_ref') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.body,'$.candidate_ref') OR
 json_extract(OLD.body,'$.baseline_refs') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.body,'$.baseline_refs') OR
 json_extract(OLD.body,'$.input_refs') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.body,'$.input_refs') OR
 json_extract(OLD.body,'$.metrics') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.body,'$.metrics') OR
 json_extract(OLD.body,'$.acceptance_contract') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.body,'$.acceptance_contract') OR
 json_extract(OLD.body,'$.stop_policy') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.body,'$.stop_policy') OR
 json_extract(OLD.body,'$.budget_policy_id') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.body,'$.budget_policy_id'))
